title: What NOT To Do If You Hit Someone With Your Car
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On November 1, 2022, dispatch received a call of a vehicle that had crashed into a bicyclist and fled the scene in Lodi, WI. After witnesses provided a description of the vehicle, the suspect vehicle was soon located with its side-view mirror missing. The driver believed they hit a sign and didn’t have time to pull over. Deputies detected an odor of intoxicants coming from her and she was ultimately placed under arrest. 

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
